drivers.lead: Marciello took the record outright with a third overall title in 2023, and nobody else has more than two
drivers.note: His first, in 2018, came when the championship was still called the Blancpain GT Series; the GT World Challenge Europe name arrived in 2020, so this record reaches across both. He won that one with SMP Racing by AKKA ASP and the 2022 and 2023 pair with AKKodis ASP, the second of them shared with Timur Boguslavskiy. Then he left: after 2023 Raffaele Marciello moved from Mercedes to BMW and into the World Endurance Championship, so three is unlikely to become four. One thing worth separating out — the figure here counts the OVERALL title only. Marciello also holds Endurance Cup and Sprint Cup titles, which are their own championships inside the same series, and counting those he has six. Charles Weerts and Boguslavskiy have two overall titles each and both are still racing, Weerts having won again in 2025.
